name: Ana
source:
A maid at Haidopair Castle who serves to [url=/c96498]Felix[/url]. Ana was assigned to take care of the slum kids while [url=/c96494]Jean[/url] is traveling. 
Ana is cheerful and energetic, always improving the mood with her presence. She loves Jean like a brother because she sees his kindness towards the slum children.
